choices.label: Poet walks past broken tambourine pieces with empty sleeves
Throbbing heart lifts out of wet sand and seats into hollow chest
Ravens perch along charred timber stumps as tide recedes
Golden mustard-seed blooms rotate their heads to track his climb
Two articulated hands waiting on bare ground are lifted
Hands snap onto wrist brads (0.0cm gap): 'I put them back on'

I2_threshold.rule: Both jointed hands lock to wrist brads (0.0cm gap) at crest of mustard incline (q_end >= 0.88).

I4_signature_constraint.constraint: Sleeves remain pinned empty until t=23.5s when hands seat onto wrists.
